title: Payment-History Courtesy in Charge Reviews — Insulin Pump Program Training Questions
content:
**Q. When a non-covered item charge on an Insulin Pump Program is reviewed, how do the customer's payments affect the supported charge?**
Where a payment posted in the three months before today and another in the three months before those, the supported charge is reduced by 5 percent (the payment-history percent); where a payment posted in the six months before today but not in both of those three-month spans, it is reduced by 2.5 percent (half the payment-history percent); otherwise there is no payment-history courtesy.

**Q. Which payments are read?**
The customer payments posted on the pump program, counted relative to today, the day of the review.

**Q. When is a payment "in the three months" before today?**
A record counts as in a number of months before today when its date is later than the same day of the month that many months before today, so a record dated exactly that many months before today is outside the window.

**Q. A customer paid twice last month and never before. Which courtesy applies?**
Both payments fall in the first three-month span and none in the span before it, so the courtesy is 2.5 percent.

**Q. A customer paid five months ago only?**
A payment in the six months, but not in both spans: 2.5 percent.

**Q. A customer has made no payment in the last six months?**
No payment-history courtesy.
